verdict.rationale: The data-model docs describe running an experiment in one project and then copying it into a separate prod project. That implies environment separation with independent flag configurations per project, but only through a single thin mention. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dev/staging/prod environments, confirmation that flag states are independent per environment, scoped or per-environment SDK/deployment keys, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: Then, copy the experiment into the prod project to run the experiment in prod.
